question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT 
        trim(mc.PID) as PID,
        CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as year,
        LAG(CAST(m.year AS INTEGER)) OVER (PARTITION BY trim(mc.PID) ORDER BY CAST(m.year AS INTEGER)) as prev_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL 
      AND m.year != '' 
      AND m.year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        PID,
        year,
        prev_year,
        year - prev_year as year_diff
    FROM actor_years
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
),
max_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        PID,
        COALESCE(MAX(year_diff), 0) as max_year_diff
    FROM gaps
    GROUP BY PID
),
all_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT trim(mc.PID) as PID
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL 
      AND m.year != '' 
      AND m.year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
)
SELECT 
    'Total actors' as metric,
    COUNT(*) as count FROM all_actors
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Actors with max_gap <= 4',
    COUNT(*) FROM all_actors a
LEFT JOIN max_gaps mg ON a.PID = mg.PID
WHERE COALESCE(mg.max_year_diff, 0) <= 4
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Actors with max_gap > 4',
    COUNT(*) FROM all_actors a
LEFT JOIN max_gaps mg ON a.PID = mg.PID
WHERE COALESCE(mg.max_year_diff, 0) > 4
